meta.name: Approve invoices with Claude vision, Google Drive, and Google Sheets

name: AI invoice approval pipeline: vision extraction, fraud checks and tiered human approval

parameters.content:
## AI invoice approval pipeline: vision extraction, fraud checks and tiered human approval

### How it works

This workflow monitors a Google Drive inbox for new invoices, downloads each file, and uses Claude vision to extract structured invoice data. It validates arithmetic, checks a Google Sheets ledger for duplicates and vendor history, then routes invoices through auto-approval or human approval based on fraud signals and thresholds. Finally, it logs the decision, moves the file to a processed or flagged folder, and sends status notifications.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Drive credentials and set the inbox, processed, and flagged folder IDs used by the trigger and move nodes.
- Configure Google Sheets credentials and ensure the ledger sheet has the columns expected by the duplicate check, vendor total calculation, and ledger logging steps.
- Add an Anthropic API key to the Claude HTTP request node and confirm the model name in the Settings node.
- Set approvalThreshold, anthropicModel, notifyWebhookUrl, and inboxFolderId in the Settings node.
- Configure the approver notification endpoint so it can return or resume the Wait node with an approval decision.

### Customization

Adjust the approval threshold, fraud rules, duplicate matching logic, vendor total criteria, and notification payloads to match the organization’s approval policy.

## Entry and settings

Starts the workflow from either the Google Drive inbox trigger or a manual test trigger, then applies shared runtime settings for thresholds, model choice, webhook URL, and folder IDs.

## Download and normalize file

Downloads the invoice from Google Drive, extracts the binary data as base64, and normalizes the file metadata/content for downstream AI processing.

## Build vision extraction

Creates the Anthropic vision request in the correct content-block format and sends the invoice image or document to Claude for extraction.

## Parse and validate extraction

Parses Claude’s JSON response, handles possible formatting wrappers, and performs deterministic invoice math validation instead of trusting model-calculated totals.

## Duplicate ledger check

Reads existing ledger entries and compares them against the extracted invoice information to detect duplicate invoices.

## Approval routing checks

Evaluates whether the invoice needs immediate review because of validation or fraud issues, then checks whether clean invoices are under the auto-approval threshold.

## Auto approval path

Automatically approves invoices that pass the review checks and fall under the configured approval threshold.

## Human approval workflow

Prepares the approval request, notifies an approver through the configured webhook, waits for a response, and applies the returned approval decision.

## Merge and vendor totals

Combines the auto-approved and human-reviewed paths, reads prior approved ledger entries for the same vendor, and computes updated vendor spend totals.

## Ledger row logging

Builds the final ledger row with invoice details, approval status, validation results, and vendor totals, then appends it to Google Sheets.

## File outcome handling

Branches on the final approval status, moves approved invoices to the processed folder or rejected/flagged invoices to the flagged folder, and sends a final outcome notification.
